en_before: Try on all the layers if you’ll add a shell. A tight shell can compress fleece at the shoulders and armholes and make it harder to move. Check width as well as length. For a day mostly indoors, choose layers you can remove easily. Our guide to layering women’s outfits helps you decide what each layer needs to do.
